full_text_zh:
[P1] 顶呱呱的呱呱先生
dǐng guā guā de guā guā xiān sheng

[P2] xiǎo qīng wā guā guā xiān sheng zài lù biān kāi le yī
小青蛙呱呱先生，在路边开了一
jiā huā diàn
家花店。
zhè shì yī jiā fēi cháng měi lì de huā diàn
这是一家非常美丽的花店。
huā diàn lǐ bǎi mǎn le gè zhǒng gè yàng de xiān huā
花店里摆满了各种各样的鲜花，
xiǎo qīng wā guā guā xiān sheng zǒng shì miàn dài wēi xiào zhàn zài
小青蛙呱呱先生总是面带微笑，站在
xiān huā cóng zhōng jiē dài měi yī wèi guāng lín de ɡù kè。
鲜花丛中，接待每一位光临的顾客。

jīn tiān rén men zǒu jìn huā diàn dōu bèi chū chuāng qián
今天，人们走进花店，都被橱窗前
bó li dà huā píng lǐ de huā xī yǐn zhù le
玻璃大花瓶里的花吸引了。
nà shì wǔ duǒ yī má yí yàng de jīn sè méi gui
那是五朵一模一样的金色玫瑰。

[P3] 一只小兔子进来看见了，他说：
“哦，五朵多么美的花，卖给我吧！”
一只百灵鸟飞落在窗台上，说：
“哦，多么香、多么可爱的花，我买一枝吧！”
小青蛙呱呱先生说：“你们挑其他花都可以，但这五朵花，已经有主人了。”
“他们是谁呢？”小兔子和百灵鸟都在想，“也许是有钱的狐狸太太，也许是阔气的金钱豹先生，也许是美丽的金丝鸟小姐吧。”

[P4] 正在这时，从花店外面走来五只小刺猬，他们穿着一样的灰色外套，戴着一样鲜红的领结，连衬衫的颜色也是一样的。
他们排着队一进门，小青蛙呱呱先生就乐了，他说：“我知道你们一定会来的！”
五只小刺猬也高兴地说：“当然要来的，今天是我们五兄弟的生日，我们要买五朵鲜花，插在每个人胸前的口袋上，我们是快乐的五胞胎兄弟！”

[P5] 原来，去年的今天，刺猬妈妈一胎生下了五只小刺猬。今天，刚好是他们一岁生日。
小青蛙呱呱先生高兴地说：“我早就记住了你们的生日，这是一个很有趣的日子。从去年的这天起，我们这儿多了五只长得一模一样的刺猬兄弟。”
“哦！他们长得真的一模一样，连穿的衣服也一样。”小兔子和百灵鸟惊叫起来。
“所以，刺猬兄弟们，我早就为你们准备好了五朵一模一样的金色玫瑰，这是我送给你们的生日礼物！”小青蛙呱呱先生举起花瓶里的金色玫瑰说。

[P6] “啊，原来是这样的，想得真周到！”小兔子和百灵鸟惊叫起来。
五只小刺猬接过小青蛙呱呱先生的金色玫瑰，把它们插在自己的胸前，
显得更神气，更美丽，也更可爱了。
他们谢了呱呱先生，又排着队走出花店。五只小刺猬迈着整齐的步子，简直像一支漂亮的仪仗队。

[P7] 可是，过了没多久，五只小刺猬又排着队走进花店。他们每人捧着一块一模一样的奶油蛋糕，这是他们送给好心的呱呱先生的礼物。
“谢谢你，顶呱呱的呱呱先生，这是我们的生日蛋糕，请你一定尝尝！”
小青蛙呱呱先生也乐了，他谢谢
有礼貌的小刺猬五兄弟。呱呱先生请小兔子和百灵鸟一起来吃蛋糕。
百灵鸟说：“谢谢你，顶呱呱、呱呱叫的呱呱先生！”
小兔子也说：“谢谢你，顶呱呱、呱呱叫的呱呱先生！”

[P8] 五只小刺猬手拉手，围着小青蛙
呱呱先生又唱又跳，他们连声说：
“谢谢顶呱呱、呱呱叫的呱呱先生！

那天，小青蛙呱呱先生的店里，
响起一片“顶呱呱”“呱呱叫”“呱
呱”“呱呱”的声音，好像大家都变
成了青蛙。
full_text_en:
[P1] Mr. Guagua, the Superb Guagua
dǐng guā guā de guā guā xiān sheng

[P2] xiǎo qīng wā guā guā xiān sheng zài lù biān kāi le yī
Mr. Frog Guagua opened a flower shop by the roadside.
jiā huā diàn
a flower shop.
zhè shì yī jiā fēi cháng měi lì de huā diàn
This is a very beautiful flower shop.
huā diàn lǐ bǎi mǎn le gè zhǒng gè yàng de xiān huā
The shop is filled with all kinds of fresh flowers.
xiǎo qīng wā guā guā xiān sheng zǒng shì miàn dài wēi xiào zhàn zài
Mr. Frog Guagua always smiles, standing
xiān huā cóng zhōng jiē dài měi yī wèi guāng lín de ɡù kè。
in the flower beds, welcoming every customer who comes.

jīn tiān rén men zǒu jìn huā diàn dōu bèi chū chuāng qián
Today, when people enter the flower shop, they are all attracted by the flowers in front of the display window.
bó li dà huā píng lǐ de huā xī yǐn zhù le
the flowers in the large glass vase.
nà shì wǔ duǒ yī má yí yàng de jīn sè méi gui
They are five identical golden roses.

[P3] A little rabbit came in and saw them. He said:
"Oh, five such beautiful flowers, sell them to me!"
A little skylark flew down to the windowsill and said:
"Oh, how fragrant and lovely the flowers are, I'll buy one!"
The little frog Mr. Gua Gua said: "You can choose any other flowers, but these five flowers already have owners."
"Who are they?" the rabbit and the skylark both thought, "Maybe it's the rich fox lady, maybe it's the generous leopard gentleman, maybe it's the beautiful golden bird lady."

[P4] At this moment, five little hedgehogs came from outside the flower shop. They were wearing identical gray coats, bright red bow ties, and even their shirts were the same color.
As they lined up and entered, Mr. Frog Gua Gua smiled and said, "I knew you'd come!"
The five little hedgehogs happily said, "Of course we're here! Today is our five brothers' birthday. We want to buy five fresh flowers to put in the pockets on our chests. We are happy quintuplet brothers!"

[P5] Originally, on this day last year, the hedgehog mother gave birth to five baby hedgehogs. Today is exactly their first birthday.
Mr. Frog Guagua happily said, "I've remembered your birthday for a long time. It's a very interesting day. Since this day last year, we've had five hedgehog brothers who look exactly the same here."
"Oh! They really look exactly the same, even their clothes are identical," the little rabbit and the lark cried out.
"So, hedgehog brothers, I've already prepared five identical golden roses for you. These are my birthday gifts for you!" Mr. Frog Guagua said, holding up the golden roses in the vase.

[P6] "Ah, so that's how it is, what thoughtful planning!" the little rabbit and the lark cried out.
The five little hedgehogs took the golden roses from Mr. Frog Gua Gua, pinned them to their chests,
and looked even more spirited, beautiful, and adorable.
They thanked Mr. Gua Gua, then lined up and walked out of the flower shop. The five little hedgehogs marched in neat steps, just like a beautiful honor guard.

[P7] But not long after, the five little hedgehogs lined up and walked into the flower shop. Each of them held a perfectly identical cream cake, a gift for the kind Mr. Guagua.
"Thank you, wonderful Mr. Guagua, this is our birthday cake, please be sure to taste it!"
The little frog Mr. Guagua was delighted and thanked them.
The polite five hedgehog brothers. Mr. Guagua invited the little rabbit and the lark to join in eating the cake.
The lark said: "Thank you, wonderful, chirping Mr. Guagua!"
The little rabbit also said: "Thank you, wonderful, chirping Mr. Guagua!"

[P8] Five little hedgehogs held hands, surrounding Little Frog.
Mr. Gua Gua jumped and sang, and they shouted in unison:
"Thank you, Top Gua Gua, Gua Gua Call, Mr. Gua Gua!"

That day, in Mr. Gua Gua the little frog's shop,
a chorus of "Top Gua Gua," "Gua Gua Call," "Gua Gua," "Gua Gua" echoed, as if everyone had turned into frogs.
full_summary_zh:
[P1] 本页为绘本标题页，竖排展示书名《顶呱呱的呱呱先生》及其拼音。
[P2] 本页介绍了小青蛙呱呱先生在路边开了一家美丽的花店，店内摆满鲜花，他总是面带微笑接待顾客。今天，人们被橱窗前玻璃大花瓶里的五朵一模一样的金色玫瑰所吸引。
[P3] 小兔子和百灵鸟被花店橱窗里的五朵金色玫瑰吸引，想买下它们，但呱呱先生告知这五朵花已有主人，他们便猜测花的主人可能是狐狸太太、金钱豹先生或金丝鸟小姐。
[P4] 五只穿着相同衣服的小刺猬来到花店，呱呱先生认出他们并欢迎他们，小刺猬们说明今天是他们五兄弟的生日，想买五朵花作为庆祝。
[P5] 本页揭示了五朵金色玫瑰的主人是五只一模一样的小刺猬兄弟，他们今天过一岁生日。小青蛙呱呱先生为他们准备了五朵金色玫瑰作为生日礼物，并向小兔子和百灵鸟解释了缘由。
[P6] 五只小刺猬接过呱呱先生送的金色玫瑰，插在胸前，显得神气又可爱，随后排着队走出花店，像一支整齐的仪仗队。
[P7] 五只小刺猬为感谢呱呱先生送的生日花，每人捧着奶油蛋糕回赠给他。呱呱先生高兴地请小兔子和百灵鸟一起品尝蛋糕，大家共同庆祝五兄弟的生日。
[P8] 五只小刺猬手拉手围着呱呱先生，感谢他送的生日花，店里响起一片模仿青蛙叫声的欢呼，仿佛所有人都变成了青蛙。
